verdict.rationale: Sentry documents custom dashboards, built by duplicating templates or saving span-based widgets from Trace Explorer queries. Its agent dashboards cover duration (average/P95), errors, token usage and model cost, so three of the four requested metric types are evidenced. Nothing in the evidence shows eval-score metrics, and no hands-on corroboration exists that these AI metrics can be charted in user-built widgets. Missing for 10: eval-score metric support in dashboards, explicit documentation of custom widgets over AI cost/latency fields, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can build custom dashboards over latency, error, cost, and eval-score metrics

citations.quote: You can also use these dashboards as templates by duplicating them to create your own custom dashboards.
You can create span-based widgets directly from [Trace Explorer](/product/trace-explorer/) queries using the "Save As" button.
**Duration**: Displays average and P95 response times for your agent executions
The Model Cost widget shows estimated costs based on token usage and model pricing.
View agent executions, model costs, token usage, tool calls, and recent errors in the Agents Dashboards.
